name: One More Simple Story
source:
The protagonist of the novel is a girl who has just arrived in a big city. As in all stories of this type, many trials await her. How she copes with them will be up to the player to decide.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/evgart]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
本作的主角是一名初来大城市的女孩。如同所有同类故事一样，等待她的将是重重考验。她会如何应对，全由玩家决定。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/evgart]Patreon[/url]]
